criteria.name: Price
criteria.description: Family plan cost for four, including renewal

criteria.name: Platform and family fit
criteria.description: iPhone, Android, Windows support and enough seats

options.name: NordPass
options.summary: XChaCha20, zero-knowledge, six-seat Family plan, cheap first-term price
options.price: $3.69/month on a one-year term, less on two-year; renews higher

options.name: 1Password
options.summary: Secret Key design, regular Cure53 audits, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001; no free tier

options.name: RoboForm
options.summary: Five-seat family plan, SOC 2 Type 2, third-party audit, no reported breach in about 25 years

options.name: Bitwarden
options.summary: Open source, multiple independent audits; family seat count and Jan 2026 audit result disputed

options.name: Keeper
options.summary: Most certified; no vault breach; expensive and enterprise-oriented

scores.rationale: Zero-knowledge XChaCha20; no breach evidence found but none affirmatively stated either.
Three sources say audited but none names the auditor or date.
Low family price, renewal increase noted.
Secret Key protects vault even on server compromise.
Regular published Cure53 audits plus SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Sources conflict on price and renewal.
No reported breach in about 25 years (absence of evidence).
SOC 2 Type 2 and one third-party audit; fewer published details.
Open source with multiple independent audits; Jan 2026 result disputed.
No vault breach reported, though two sources are vendor-adjacent.
Highest annual cost for five users.

recommendation.headline: NordPass Family is the best balance for four people on iPhone, Android and Windows, with 1Password as the audit-first alternative
recommendation.summary: NordPass covers all three platforms, gives six private vaults, has zero-knowledge encryption and a low family price, but its audit details are thin.

reasons.text: Zero-knowledge XChaCha20 design, reported as independently audited by three sources
Works on iPhone, Android and Windows
Low family price, though it rises at renewal

tradeoffs.text: Audit evidence is less specific than 1Password or Keeper

alternatives.when: Audit transparency matters more than price
Open source matters and the seat count is confirmed

caveats: Auditor names for NordPass not given in sources

contradictions.assessment: Source 2 says zero critical findings; source 7 says two critical. Source 2 is dated 2023 yet describes 2026 and has lower reliability (54 vs 67), but neither links the report. Unresolved.
Source 9 says $5.99/month; source 7 says renews at $9.99/month. Unresolved.
Sources 2 and 9 say six users; source 7 says three. Majority favours six but unverified.

uncertainties.text: No source names NordPass's auditor or audit date
Keeper breach record rests on vendor-adjacent sources
Prices are promotional and vary by source
